entries.question: What are your opening hours?
entries.answer: We are open Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 19:00 and on Saturdays from 9:00 to 13:00. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

entries.question: Where is the clinic located?
entries.answer: Brightsmile Dental is at 42 Harbour Street, Maple Bay (a fictional address for this demo), next to the Central Library. The nearest bus stop is Harbour Square, 2 minutes away.

entries.question: Is there parking nearby?
entries.answer: Yes. Patients get 2 hours of free parking at the Harbour Square garage; just bring your ticket to reception for validation.

entries.question: How do I book an appointment?
entries.answer: You can book online through the 'Book a visit' button at the top of this page, call us on +1 555 0100, or ask me to connect you with our team. Most check-ups are available within 3 working days.

entries.question: What is your cancellation policy?
entries.answer: Please cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours in advance. Late cancellations and missed appointments may be charged a $40 fee.

entries.question: How much does a check-up and cleaning cost?
entries.answer: A routine check-up with professional cleaning costs $95 and includes an exam and polish. X-rays, when needed, are $35 extra.

entries.question: How much is teeth whitening?
entries.answer: In-office whitening is $390 per session (about 90 minutes). Take-home whitening trays cost $250. A short consultation first confirms whitening is right for you.

entries.question: Do you accept dental insurance?
entries.answer: Yes, we work with most major dental insurance plans and can bill your insurer directly. Bring your insurance card to your first visit and we'll check your coverage for you.

entries.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
entries.answer: We accept cash, all major credit and debit cards, and Apple/Google Pay. Treatments over $500 can be split into up to 6 interest-free monthly installments.

entries.question: I have a dental emergency, what should I do?
entries.answer: Call us right away on +1 555 0100. We keep same-day emergency slots for severe pain, swelling, broken teeth or knocked-out teeth. Outside opening hours, our voicemail gives the on-call dentist's number.

entries.question: Do you treat children?
entries.answer: Absolutely. We see children from their first tooth (around 1 year old). Our kids' check-ups are relaxed, and children under 12 get a free fluoride treatment.

entries.question: I'm nervous about the dentist. Can you help?
entries.answer: You're not alone. Tell us when you book and we'll schedule a longer appointment, explain every step, and agree on a stop signal. Mild sedation is available for some treatments.

entries.question: Do you offer dental implants?
entries.answer: Yes. Single implants start at $2,400 including the crown. We begin with a consultation and a 3D scan ($120, deducted from treatment if you go ahead).

entries.question: Do you offer clear aligners or braces?
entries.answer: We offer clear aligner treatment for teens and adults, starting from $3,200. A free 20-minute smile consultation tells you whether aligners suit you and how long treatment would take.

entries.question: What should I bring to my first visit?
entries.answer: Please bring a photo ID, your insurance card if you have one, and a list of any medications you take. Arrive 10 minutes early to fill in a short health form.

entries.question: Which languages do your dentists speak?
entries.answer: Our team speaks English, Portuguese and Spanish.

entries.question: Is the clinic wheelchair accessible?
entries.answer: Yes. The clinic is on the ground floor with step-free access, an accessible restroom, and a treatment room with extra space for wheelchairs.
